name: minecart-furnace-push
comment: WP-2.4b. A straight rail along x at z = 0 (x = -7..7, a stone wall at x = 8), chunks within 3 preloaded. The player (id 0) stands off the track at (-7.5, 61, 3.5). A furnace cart (id 1, "type": 2), a plain cart (id 2) and a chest cart (id 3, "type": 1) are on the rail. At t = 2 the interact op with 2 coal in the hand: EntityMinecart.interact of a furnace cart (EntityMinecart.java:776-788) takes one coal (stackSize 1 left, the op's stack), adds 1200 fuel and sets the push vector away from the player; sendUseItem then does nothing with the coal. The furnace cart runs on its push (:336-353, :381-394: motion * 0.8 + push * 0.04, the push following the motion), smoking one tick in four on its rand (:485-492), runs into the plain cart (applyEntityCollision, the furnace-vs-plain branches :684-695) which runs into the chest cart, and all three jam against the wall with the furnace cart still pushing. At t = 3 interact on the chest cart: its GUI (displayGUIChest) is client code and a recorded gap; the result is true. Only the carts are dumped (the player's own update is WP-2.5). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
